description: This file defines the interface for the CCSP Message Bus Service, including function prototypes for engaging with the message bus, initializing and finalizing the service, sending signals, handling messages, and registering with the control registry. It also contains licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: ssp_TadMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages the component with the message bus using specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_TadMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user data.

methods.name: ssp_TadMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up resources associated with the message bus interface.

methods.name: ssp_TadMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the status of the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_TadMbi_GetHealth
methods.description: Retrieves the health status of the message bus service.

methods.name: ssp_TadMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources with a specified priority and user data.

methods.name: ssp_TadMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a parameter value change signal with old and new values to the specified access list.

methods.name: ssp_TadMbi_SendTransferCompleteSignal
methods.description: Signals that a transfer has completed.

methods.name: CcspTandD_path_message_func
methods.description: Handles incoming DBus messages for the specified path.

methods.name: ssp_TadMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers the component to the control registry with provided namespace parameters.

methods.name: ssp_TadMbi_WaitConditionReady
methods.description: Waits until a specified condition on the message bus is ready.
